build_chroma_extractor: build a ChromaExtractor module to extract chroma features from audio waveforms at a given sample rate
create_chroma_extractor_with_argmax: create a ChromaExtractor with argmax enabled to produce one-hot chroma representations from audio
extract_chroma_features: extract normalized chroma features from a waveform tensor using the ChromaExtractor forward pass
customize_chroma_extractor_params: customize ChromaExtractor with custom nfft, winlen, and winhop parameters for fine-grained STFT control
review_chroma_extractor_norm: review the ChromaExtractor class and its chroma normalization using configurable Lp norm values
